recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce resourceType-named elements under SubscriptionTopic trigger/filter/shape structures; future SubscriptionTopic trigger model changes should be tracked under their own Jira issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting that SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resourceType be renamed because resourceType conflicts with the JSON serialization pseudo-element; the accepted resolution was to use SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resource.
initial_application: The rename was pre-applied in source history. Commit d6a7fe20f9258525ddc48b03a71b313545b30849 updated the related SubscriptionTopic search parameter from resource-type/resourceTrigger.resourceType to resource/resourceTrigger.resource.
additional_context: FHIR-46492 later collapsed SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger and SubscriptionTopic.eventTrigger into SubscriptionTopic.trigger for R6. Current source/fhir.ini lists SubscriptionTopic as active and maps the old R5 SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resource path to SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource. FHIR-I WGM minutes from January 2022 also record that the FHIR-32783 name change was already applied when the group voted persuasive.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
